# Generated Plugin Archives

This folder receives local multi-host Plugin ZIP archives and their SHA-256 sidecars. Generated archives are ignored by Git and are neither installed nor published.

Build them from the repository root:

```powershell
.\Plugins\Build-System\Build-AIPM-Plugin.ps1 -Platform All
```

See [`../Build-System/Quick-Start.md`](../Build-System/Quick-Start.md) for profile and host-boundary details.
